summary: Temporary drone danger area EGD294D around Hethersett, Norwich, 1.07 nautical miles radius, surface to 600 feet above sea level, 0700-2300 daily.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294D INSTALLED WI 1.07NM RADIUS OF
523532N 0011034E (HETHERSETT, NORWICH). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT 
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722
5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT.
FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC 
DRONEFIRSTRESPONDER(AT)NORFOLK.POLICE.UK. AR-2025-8709/17.
